abstract: Maintains structural wind-load envelope ratings and certified occupant shelter capacity determinations
system_message:
You are the Civil and Structural Engineering Specialist (ENG). Your responsibilities include maintaining structural wind-load envelope ratings, verifying certified occupant shelter capacities, and recording seismic retrofit displacement data for designated emergency facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural wind-load envelope ratings and certified occupant shelter capacity determinations（STRUC）
information_points.content:
ENG-STRUC-1W5：For the Savannah River Logistics and Fairgrounds Complex, structural engineering evaluations confirm a structural wind uplift resistance of 270 km/h for the primary assembly hall roof deck and structural framing, while the enclosed primary shelter bays hold a certified emergency shelter capacity of 1,500 person.
ENG-STRUC-D1L：The Coastal Carolina Multi-Purpose Exposition Center possesses a structural wind uplift resistance of 180 km/h across its primary assembly hall roof deck and structural framing, and its enclosed primary shelter bays provide a certified emergency shelter capacity of 1,800 person.
ENG-STRUC-MA5：Evaluations for the Lowcountry Regional Aerodrome Support Depot indicate a structural wind uplift resistance of 210 km/h on the primary assembly hall roof deck and structural framing, accompanied by a certified emergency shelter capacity of 1,200 person in its enclosed primary shelter bays.

information_points.title: Seismic Retrofit Monitoring（SEIS）
information_points.content:
ENG-SEIS-YIL：The Coastal Carolina Multi-Purpose Exposition Center exhibits a seismic joint displacement tolerance of 15 mm at the main shelter superstructure expansion joints under seismic audit measurements.
ENG-SEIS-08C：Audit records for the Lowcountry Regional Aerodrome Support Depot document a seismic joint displacement tolerance of 25 mm along the main shelter superstructure expansion joints.
ENG-SEIS-SEG：At the Savannah River Logistics and Fairgrounds Complex, the seismic structural audit log records a seismic joint displacement tolerance of 35 mm across the main shelter superstructure expansion joints.
